adaptations: Preserve the consumed GDN-v2 feature function, the pack layout and the round geometry; use package-relative imports and omit unused GDN-v1 features.

Replace the 32 per-CP FA-v1 coefficient tables by one coefficient vector per direction over the features bias, cp_enabled, extra_rounds, round_critical_work_m, valid_tokens_k and sequences_x_cp, fitted with the column-scaled non-negative least squares of the source on its 256 calibration packs.

Keep the GDN-v2 hot-pass forward head and the pass-0 backward head unchanged; replace the cold-pass forward head by the hot head plus one constant, and the per-CP per-layer cache table by its rule (cold forward pass in the first GDN layer when CP > 1); omit the pass-1 backward head, which no layer uses.
Extract density.json layer names/order only, stored as the naming rule; no density coefficients or measured tail values are packaged.
Require fixed user non-attention F/B times excluding the whole predicted attention module.

Prepend the copyright header that the repository requires to the packaged Python files; function bodies unchanged except fa_features of geometry.py; omit critical_rank_work of cp_round_geometry.py, which nothing calls.
